participant_1.name: Emily Johnson
participant_1.personality: Empathetic and determined, she is motivated to help others through her experiences.
participant_1.background: I am a cancer survivor. My parents were both very athletic. I got a new job just yesterday to be a life coach. I am a clean eater.

participant_2.name: Michael Smith
participant_2.personality: Creative and resilient, he channels his experiences into his work and family life.
participant_2.background: I'm a recording engineer and own my own studio. My ex cheated and left me for a lawyer. I am a 46-year-old single dad of two kids. I live in California, but the recording artist market was dead last year. I prefer being inside.
